newsitem.title: UK: Park Food Group jumps after interim results.
newsitem.headline: Park Food Group jumps after interim results.

text.p: Shares in Park Food Group jumped on Friday after the UK retailer and wholesaler of hampers and vouchers announced a reduction in half-year losses and said the full-year outlook was positve.
Shares in the company rose seven pence or 14.14 percent to 56-1/2p by 0909 GMT.
The group reported losses before tax of 5.2 million stg for the half year to September 30, 1996 versus 5.7 million stg for the same period the year before.
"Our High Street Voucher operation continues to grow market share and we believe it is now the second most popular in the UK," group chairman Peter Johnson said.
"We expect mail order and packing turnover for the year to March 1997 to increase by around 20 million pounds."

In a statement, the company said full-year profits at its marketing services company HSL would be significantly up on the previous year's figure of 0.3 million stg but would not reach the 2.0 million stg earned in 1994/95.
